ios.desc:
Feeling overwhelmed, anxious, or stressed? Struggling with depression, loneliness, or relationship issues? 7 Cups provides a trusted space for mental health support, professional therapy, stress relief and emotional support from experts—right from your phone. Whether you need licensed counseling sessions, peer support, mental health services, talk therapy, advice or mindfulness exercises for anxiety and depression, we’re here to help with evidence-based practices and emotional guidance.

Connect with Licensed Therapists & Trained Listeners
• 24/7 emotional support through 1-on-1 text, chats and video with trained listener hotlines—for free. 
• Online therapy and counseling services with licensed professionals for deeper guidance.
• Join community, private and closed support groups, mental health forums & chat rooms to share experiences and find encouragement.

Mental Health Support for Anxiety, Stress & Depression
• Manage anxiety and panic attacks with guided mindfulness and therapeutic breathing exercises.
• Reduce stress and boost your mood with over 300 free mental health exercises, self-care activities, and virtual guides.
• Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) techniques to help reframe negative thoughts.
• Personalized self help tools and mental health care with our free wellness test.

Why Choose 7 Cups for Counseling & Therapy?

• Confidential & Anonymous: Your identity remains private—even from your therapist or listener. 
• Flexible & Affordable: Free emotional support sessions and low-cost online therapy options for individuals without insurance.
• Recognized & Trusted Treatments: An award-winning mental health app, acknowledged by Stanford MedicineX for innovation in healthcare.
• Inclusive & Accepting: We support everyone, regardless of age, gender, sex, or background
• Group support: Share your experiences and gain new insights in support groups with licensed therapists.

Find Support Anytime, Anywhere

Life’s challenges don’t follow a schedule. Whether you’re dealing with work stress, anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship problems, divorce self-esteem issues or you just want to talk to someone, finding a therapist or counselor can be a time-consuming and expensive process. You can’t always talk to friends, family, or coworkers, that’s why 7 Cups provides instant mental health support, remote counseling services, advice, and stress relief—anytime you need it. 

100% Confidential Mental Health Help & Chat:

quotes.text:
7 Cups of Tea is looking for a Lead Product/UI/UX Designer. You will lead our team in creating simple and intuitive interfaces for our Web and mobile products.

About 7 Cups:

Mental health is in a state of crisis. One in four adults suffers from mental illness in a given year, and it is the leading cause of disability in the United States. Sadly, many people never seek help due to the stigma and expense surrounding therapy and other forms of care.

7 Cups of Tea (7 Cups) addresses this problem by using technology to bring compassion and a loving, listening ear into our communities:

--7 Cups graduated from the Y Combinator in Silicon Valley in 2013. We are a peer to peer emotional support system. Whenever someone is feeling depressed or lonely, they can get anonymous emotional support from trained active listeners on 7 Cups to feel better. They can use it whenever they want—it’s available on-demand, 24/7, worldwide.

--Over 100,000 people from 158 countries (in 130 different languages) use the platform each week. We have helped over 2,000,000 people.

--7 Cups has partnered with Active Minds, Tumblr, and other high profile companies and nonprofits.

--7 Cups is backed by the best and brightest investors (leading firms and many YC partners).

About the Position:

7 Cups of Tea (S 2013) is looking for a very talented, extraordinarily productive, conscientious, emotionally intelligent, purpose seeking engineer to join our team. We are very interested in people that care deeply about making the world a much better place.

Our work environment is one where you will experience autonomy, mastery, and purpose. We are not micromanagers. We need your big brain engaged, challenged, and solving hard problems. Your work will directly impact the emotional well-being of millions of people. Please read these app reviews and ask yourself if you’d like to play a key role in helping us create the future of mental health.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sevencupsoftea.app&hl=en

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/7-cups-tea-free-anxiety-relief/id921814681?mt=8

We are hard working, creative, and respectful people. Our team deeply understands the stressors involved in startups (www.7cupsoftea.com/startups) and we deliberately create a healthy atmosphere where all can thrive. We have the good fortune of being backed by the best and brightest investors. Mental health is an enormous opportunity (7% of healthcare costs in the US alone). We’ve made a great deal of progress and we are just getting started. 
Working remotely is okay.

Requirements:

- HTML5/CSS3/Bootstrap: This stuff is easy for you.
- PHP Expert and solid understanding of OOP
- Javascript/jQuery Expert - You've got an excellent grasp of the language. You're familiar with …
